proposals.evidence: DEDR 497 directly gives Kannada ele/ela ‘leaf’. The survey yele/yelē/yɛlē forms have the same simple leaf sense and a vowel-initial stem with written initial glide; source-specific vowel notation is preserved. The census record is tagged uncertain; this proposal retains that source uncertainty and does not certify the transcription. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
